plugin.name: Splinter Cell Double Agent PCSX2F Fusion Fix
PS2.MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skips the logo movie at startup. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
PS2.HUD.HudScale.description: Scale the HUD within its aspect-correct area.
PS2.ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows the emulator display; otherwise enter a width:height ratio.
PS2.HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places HUD elements at screen edges; a ratio constrains them to a centered box.
PS2.FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay camera's field of view; 1.0 is the original framing. Cutscenes, scripted scenes, aiming and gadget views keep their own framing.
PS2.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original keeps the game's 4:3 picture. Fill scales the whole movie to the screen at its own aspect ratio.
PS2.cinema.description: Black bars for single-player cutscenes. Letterbox keeps the original bars above and below, Pillarbox adds bars at the sides that keep the original framing, Both combines them, Off fills the screen.
PS2.cinema.animated.description: Let cutscene bars slide in and out.
PS2.language.description: Choose the language used for plugin notices. Auto uses English.
